response.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT ID, HGB, APTT - PT AS aptt_minus_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE UA > 3.9
),
per_patient AS (
  SELECT ID,
         AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
         AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_hgb,
       AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
FROM per_patient;

assumptions.assumption: A patient is identified by Laboratory.ID, and each patient's two averages use only that patient's records with UA > 3.9. A record with NULL HGB, APTT, or PT is skipped for the average it affects, so a patient with no valid value for one metric drops out of that metric's cross-patient average only. Results are unrounded because SQLite does not round unless asked.
